name: eugenol
uses: Uses temporarily relieves throbbing, persistent toothache due to a cavity until a dentist can be seen
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a dentist or doctor if irritation persists, inflammation develops, or if fever and infection develop See a dentist as soon as possible whether or not the pain is relieved. Toothaches and open cavities indicate serious problems that need prompt attention by a dentist.
